title: Camptown Races
commons_title: File:Gwine to Run all Night (Harry C. Browne, 1916).ogg
composition: words and music by Stephen Foster (1850); public domain
credit: Recording from 1916 by Harry C. Browne, public domain. The Commons file keeps the original dialect title; this package uses the standard title and modern spelling.
lyrics: The Camptown ladies sing this song
The Camptown race track five miles long
I come down there with my hat caved in
I go back home with a pocket full of tin
I bet my money on a bob-tailed nag
